title: JdbcUrlPolicy hardening gaps: Properties deny-list skips H2 token check; JdbcUser/JdbcPassword appended unescaped into Mondrian connect string

criteria.given: an H2 datasource URL and an info Properties map carrying an H2 executable token (INIT=/RUNSCRIPT/CREATE ALIAS/SHUTDOWN)
criteria.then: the info-properties check runs the same H2 executable-token scan as the URL check

criteria.given: a Mondrian datasource or cube-designer preview whose JdbcUser/JdbcPassword contains ';Key='
criteria.then: both connect-string builders quote the credential through one shared helper instead of concatenating it raw
